notablePrerequisites:
The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 11.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating a Blood token plus at least one additional artifact token due to Tippy-Toe.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two artifacts, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.
